meditation_mats.name: Courtyard Mats
meditation_mats.description: Basic woven mats in the courtyard for collective breathing exercises.

grand_kitchen.name: Grand Kitchen
grand_kitchen.description: A facility capable of feeding hundreds of disciples properly.

massive_kitchen.name: Massive Kitchen
massive_kitchen.description: An upgraded kitchen complex capable of supporting grand banquets and large sect feasts.

alchemy_furnace.name: Bronze Alchemy Furnace
alchemy_furnace.description: A heavy furnace for refining basic medicinal herbs into restorative pills.

grand_alchemy_lab.name: Grand Alchemy Laboratory
grand_alchemy_lab.description: A full refining complex with multiple furnaces and herb storage vaults.

martial_arena.name: Sparring Arena
martial_arena.description: A stone-paved ring for disciples to safely test their forms and spar under supervision.

grand_training_hall.name: Grand Training Hall
grand_training_hall.description: An enclosed training hall with proper equipment racks, targets, and training dummies.

disciple_barracks.name: Disciple Barracks
disciple_barracks.description: Proper sleeping quarters for outer and inner disciples. Improves living conditions significantly.

elder_courtyard.name: Elder's Private Courtyard
elder_courtyard.description: A secluded courtyard with personal meditation chambers for the sect's Elders. They are noticeably more at ease.

qi_circulation_chamber.name: Inner Qi Circulation Chamber
qi_circulation_chamber.description: A sealed stone room saturated with ambient spiritual energy. Extended sessions here accelerate meridian development.

weapons_vault.name: Weapons Vault
weapons_vault.description: A secured armory housing a variety of weapons for disciples to train with and study.

herb_garden.name: Medicinal Herb Garden
herb_garden.description: A carefully tended garden of healing herbs. Supplements the sect's medical supplies each month.

trade_hall.name: Trade Hall
trade_hall.description: A formal trading pavilion that facilitates commerce with traveling merchants and other sects.

council_hall.name: Council Hall
council_hall.description: A formal chamber for Elder councils and sect governance. Legitimizes council votes and improves deliberation quality.

spy_network.name: Shadow Information Network
spy_network.description: A web of informants, coded couriers, and dead-drops woven through neighboring territories.

ancestral_shrine.name: Ancestral Shrine
ancestral_shrine.description: A sacred hall honoring the sect's founders and fallen elders. Improves karmic standing and morale.

grand_gate.name: Grand Sect Gate
grand_gate.description: An imposing ceremonial gate that announces the sect's prestige to all who approach.

poison_laboratory.name: Hidden Poison Laboratory
poison_laboratory.description: A concealed lab for studying poisons, antidotes, and assassination techniques. Associated with Sichuan culture.
